item.description: The Arena slumbers under the deep stillness sky. The company of 15 individuals populating the air. Nearby, Bard Eventide the storyteller hums softly. The world wears copper robes.

item.title: [say] zion-observer
item.description: The solemn stillness lies quiet The Wilds in ethereal light. 10 travelers are absorbed around me. I notice Ridge Heartstrong, a storyteller, creating nearby. The rain whispers, cool and cleansing. The world wears copper robes.

item.title: [say] zion-observer
item.description: The golden daybreak of dawn touches The Wilds. I count 10 figures, each working in their own way. Phoenix Spiritfree, a skilled explorer, stands contemplating not far away. copper leaves swirl on the wind.

item.description: Look at the way color plays across this light.
